text:
Rina (People Ops): Quick maintenance alert for the SF HQ: Elevator modernization + parking lot repaving this Fri evening (Mar 5) through Mon morning (Mar 8). Building access will be limited overnight and there will be alternate entry instructions. Full details below and on the intranet: https://intra.redwood.example/ops/sf-maintenance
Facility Ops Bot: "Work Order #45812: Elevator modernization (Zone A bank) - start: 2026-03-05 18:00 - end: 2026-03-08 07:00. Parking lot repave - partial closure."
Jared (eng): Will the front lobby be open? I sometimes arrive early for hardware deliveries.
Tomas (reception): Lobby stays open 7:30-19:00 Fri, Sat, Sun during maintenance but the west elevator (A bank) will be offline. Use east elevator (B bank) or the stairwell. Early morning deliveries before 7:30 need pre-arranged gate code via facilities@redwood.ai.
Maya (sales): Parking? I drive in from the East Bay.
Olivia (People Ops): On-site parking will be reduced to ~30% capacity. If you usually park, we issued temporary remote-parking vouchers for nearby lot at 8th & Pine. If you need a validated spot due to medical reason or heavy equipment, email ppl-ops@redwood.ai by Tue EOD.
Jared (eng): Any shuttle options from BART? Parking changes might push people to transit.
Rina (People Ops): We9ll run a free shuttle from Montgomery BART to the office at 7:45 AM and 8:15 AM on Mon morning. Return trips to Montgomery at 6:30 PM and 7:00 PM. Sign up: https://forms.redwood.example/shuttle-mar8
Ava (Accessibility): Note for folks who require step-free access: we9ve reserved the service elevator for ADA access during the entire outage window. Please ping accessibility@redwood.ai to reserve a slot or request assistance on arrival.
Maya (sales): Are on-call engineers allowed to work onsite overnight if needed?
Olivia (People Ops): Overnight onsite presence is generally NOT allowed for safety during repaving (heavy machinery after hours). If an exception is required for critical on-call work, managers must file an exception with security@redwood.ai and cc ppl-ops. Exceptions are rare and need a safety plan.
Jared (eng): Got it. Will there be noise that disrupts meetings? We have a customer demo Friday evening.
Rina (People Ops): Friday evening demo — try to reschedule to earlier in the day or move to the dedicated Demo Room 4 (north wing) which will have noise dampening in place. If you need help booking, contact rooms@redwood.ai.
Tomas (reception): Badge re-entry: due to construction gates, re-entry after 7:00 PM will require checking in with security desk and showing badge + government ID.
Facility Ops Bot: "Temporary entrance map: West lot closed. Use Visitor Entrance (2nd St) or Loading Dock for deliveries. Map: https://intra.redwood.example/assets/sf-maint-map.png"
Ava (Accessibility): Also flagging lactation room relocation: Room 5B will be closed; we9ve moved a private lactation/quiet room to 2R (near HR) with a key code. Contact accessibility@redwood.ai for code.
Maya (sales): Will food deliveries (catered lunches) be impacted? We have a client lunch Sat.
Olivia (People Ops): Catering deliveries must use the loading dock and arrive between 11:00-12:00. If your booking falls outside that window, reschedule or use a nearby coworking kitchen. We9ll update the booking team.
Jared (eng): Any temporary Wi-Fi changes? I9ll bring a PoE switch for a demo.
Facility Ops Bot: "Network impact: No planned network maintenance. Wi-Fi and wired access remain available. Some contractor access points may be active near the lot; SSID: Redwood-Contractor (isolated)."
GCal Bot: "SF HQ: Elevator + Parking Maintenance — Mar 5 18:00 to Mar 8 07:00
Shuttle: Montgomery BART -> SF HQ Mar 8 07:45, 08:15; Return 18:30, 19:00
Please review guidelines and RSVP for shuttles by Mar 6."
Rina (People Ops): TL;DR action items: 1) If you need parking or medical exceptions, email ppl-ops by Tue EOD; 2) Reserve ADA assistance via accessibility@redwood.ai; 3) Sign up for shuttle if affected; 4) Move/confirm any deliveries via loading dock window. Let us know here if you have questions. :wrench:
Maya (sales): Thanks for the clear steps 84
Jared (eng): Thanks! I9ll reschedule the Friday demo to earlier.
Olivia (People Ops): We9ll post a follow-up with the PDF map and updated shuttle signups tomorrow.
